sequential.method: Measured 2026-10-17 from one server in Germany: all 180 chat messages of this page, one request at a time, identical request (same state text and the same four-option choice question) to api.decisionmodels.io (model s1-fast, served as s1-fast-2) and to api.typesafe.ai (model jev-1.14.0). Round-trip latency includes the network. 'Matches intended label' compares with the demo author's own labels, which are not a benchmark. List prices from each provider's public pricing page on the same day (USD per 1M input tokens; output free on both).
